title: Viva Engage: community feeds default to all posts, sorted by recent posts
summary: The briefing's default, affected users, feed behaviour and rollout window are supported by Microsoft's supplied notice and roadmap record. No actionable inaccuracies were found. The after-rollout checklist should describe completion by the end of November as expected, not guaranteed.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no tenant-wide UI or automation control to preserve the previous community feed default.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Engage community feed default admin settings PowerShell Microsoft Graph'; 'Viva Engage community feed disable default new recent activity tenant community settings'.
